# iD Tech

> > iD Tech offers STEM summer camps, coding courses, and teen academies teaching game development, robotics, and programming at university campuses nationwide and online.

iD Tech provides technology education for kids and teens through hands-on learning in Minecraft modding, Roblox development, Unreal Engine, Python, Java, C++, and more. Programs are held at prestigious university locations including Santa Clara University, Loyola University, and University of Washington, with options for both in-person and virtual learning.

## Key Topics

- Summer camps and STEM education
- Minecraft modding and coding with Java
- Roblox game development
- Unreal Engine 5 game creation
- Python, C++, and Java programming
- Teen coding academies (2-week intensive programs)
- Video editing with Adobe Premiere
- Robotics programs (BattleBots, VEX)
- Scratch programming for beginners
- Private coding tutoring
- University campus locations nationwide
- Online and virtual learning options
- Parent resources and at-home activities
- Counselor recruitment and training
- YouTube and TikTok content creation

## Core Programs & Courses

- [Minecraft Summer Camps | 2026 | Coding & More | Online & Near You](https://www.idtech.com/minecraft-summer-camps): Minecraft coding, modding, and game development camps using Java
- [Unreal Summer Camps for Kids & Teens | Game Engine Classes from iD Tech](https://www.idtech.com/unreal-summer-camps): Unreal Engine 5 game development camps for kids and teens
- [Video Editing Classes for Kids & Teens | Online & Near You](https://www.idtech.com/video-editing-courses-programs): Video editing courses for kids using Adobe Premiere, YouTube, TikTok
- [Chicago Coding Classes for Kids | Locations & Courses Near You](https://www.idtech.com/coding-courses-programs/chicago): Chicago-area coding classes in Python, Java, C++ at Loyola University

## Teen Academies & Campus Programs

- [iD Tech Academies Held at UW](https://www.idtech.com/campus-academies-uw-seattle): Two-week teen coding academy at University of Washington Seattle campus
